name: Thaumaturgy (Sielanic Path of the Silent Dead) — Intermediate — Army of Souls

system.description:
The second of the Telyavelic Tremere's two Sielanic Thaumaturgical Paths (the source text's original title for this Path is illegible in the surviving copy, and "Sielanic Path of the Silent Dead" is an editorial label rather than a confirmed canon name), it uses the caster's own unliving body as a conduit for contact with the world of the dead. At its highest levels the sorcerer can touch the essence of Telyavel, the Lithuanian death-god, himself. Like its sister Path, it disappears with the Telyavelic bloodline's extinction, though rumor holds some of its principles were subsumed into Dark Thaumaturgy and other infernal Disciplines.

The practitioner raises a spectral troop of ethereal, tattered warriors to defend her or deliver warnings to her enemies. Though they cannot fully materialize, they can hurl objects and terrify attackers.

System: Successes determine how many mindless ghostly Drones answer the summons; they return to rest at the end of the night they were called.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers (Tremere)
system.discipline: Thaumaturgy (Sielanic Path of the Silent Dead)
system.duration: Until the end of the night summoned
